type: Overlock / serger sewing machine (包缝机) integrated controller
source: C4B-25A包缝机说明书-(中英文).pdf (JK-EC4B-25A Integrated Control Box Instructions V1.1, 18 pages, bilingual Chinese/English)
note: The JK-EC4B-25A is a 9-button + 4-digit LED display controller for overlock/serger machines. Features three optical sensors (front, rear, anti-cutting-cloth) for automatic thread trimming. Sewing modes: B=Semi-automatic, BA=Semi-automatic thin/mesh fabric, BS=Semi-automatic big-hole fabric, C=Full computer mode. The 1st digit on display shows working mode (B/C), 4th digit scrolls marquee.

specs.startupDisplay: All 4 tubes and 5 indicator lights on → chip version Vx.xx → standby interface

panel.type: 9-button panel with 4-digit LED and 5 indicator lights
indicators: Front sensor indication (前传感器指示)
Rear sensor indication (后传感器指示)
Anti-cutting-cloth sensor indication (防切布传感器指示)

buttons.name: P — Parameter entry/confirm key
functions: Long press: enter user parameter adjustment mode
Short press: confirm parameter or return to standby

buttons.name: + (Speed add / parameter increment)
functions: Short press in standby: quick increase max speed (100 RPM per press)
Short/Long press in param mode: increase parameter value

buttons.name: - (Speed reduce / parameter decrement)
functions: Short press in standby: quick decrease max speed (100 RPM per press)
Short/Long press in param mode: decrease parameter value

buttons.name: LED /> key (right page / LED brightness)
functions: Short press in standby: cycle LED brightness L0→L1→L2→L3 (off, level 1, 2, 3); auto-saved
Short press in parameter mode: page to next parameter (increasing direction)

buttons.name: Mesh /< key (fabric type select / left page)
functions: Long press 2s: enter fabric selection — shows current type (B0=normal, A=thin/mesh, S=big hole); short press to switch; short press P to save
Short press in parameter mode: page to previous parameter (decreasing direction)

buttons.name: Reset button
functions: Long press 2s: restore user-defined parameters (display flashes all, then shows OK)
Long press Mesh+LED both 2s: restore factory settings

buttons.name: Presser foot lift button
functions: Short press: cycle presser foot modes: front lift before sewing → rear lift after sewing → front+rear → closed → ...
Long press: enter fabric recognition mode (material detection)

buttons.name: Thread trimming / scissors button
functions: Short press: cycle trimmer mode: no trim(0) → front trim before sewing(1) → rear trim after sewing(2) → front+rear(3) → ...
Long press 2s: unlock panel (when P62=1 locked, all buttons except this one are locked)

buttons.name: Sensor button
functions: Short press: sensor emit strength parameter quick adjustment
Long press 1s: sensor auto-calibration mode (auto-adjust sensor PWM); shows OK on success, A-01/A-04 on failure

userParams.access: Long press P → user parameter interface. Navigate with </> (Mesh/LED buttons) or short/long press. Press +/- to change value. Short press P to save (shows OK). No button action within 5s → auto-return to standby.

technicianParams.access: Long press P + Presser foot lift button simultaneously → technician parameter interface. Navigate and adjust same as user params.

systemParams.access: Long press P + '+' button simultaneously for 1s+ → password interface (shows 000_) → enter password → navigate and adjust. Short press P to save.

monitoring.access: Long press P + LED button simultaneously → monitoring interface. Navigate with </> or LED. Short press P to view value. Press any button except Reset to exit, or short press P at M-00 to return to standby.

parameterEntry.speedAdjust: Short press +/- in standby: adjusts max speed (P-01) ±100 RPM per press with auto-save.
parameterEntry.sewingModeSwitch: Short press trimmer key to cycle mode; when trimmer mode=0 (off) both indicators off, system auto-links to full computer C mode. When trimmer mode=1/2/3, system auto-links to semi-automatic B mode.
parameterEntry.modeSwitch: P5=0 = Full computer C mode; P5=1 = Semi-automatic B mode.
parameterEntry.buttonLock: P62=1: all buttons except trimmer locked; long press trimmer 2s to unlock (P62 auto-clears to 0, shows UL). When unlocked: long press trimmer 2s to force reset piece count (shows CLC).

steps: Long press Mesh button to confirm fabric type (normal/mesh/big hole fabric)
Long press Presser foot button to start fabric recognition
Display shows F, put fabric in (must block all 3 sensors)
Decimal point flashes: fabric inserted successfully, keep still
Display shows OK: recognition successful. Display shows Er: failure.

parameterEntry.sensorAutoCalibration: Long press Sensor button 1s → sensor PWM auto-adjust mode. Shows OK if successful, shows A-01/A-02/A-03/A-04 on failure.
parameterEntry.antiCuttingClothShortcut: Long press P + Sensor button for 3s: toggle anti-cutting cloth sensor on/off.
parameterEntry.customUserParams: Adjust parameters as needed, then set P21=1. System saves current params as user-defined custom params (shows OK).
parameterEntry.sleepMode: P55=2: force system into sleep mode. In sleep, machine light off, display shows OFF, last decimal point flickers. Short press any button to exit sleep.

agingMode.modeA: Motor+solenoid running. P55=1, press pedal at middle. System enters aging A mode.
agingMode.modeB: Solenoid running only. P56=1. System first runs hardware detection (motor turns to different positions, shows LP...), then OK, then aging B mode.
agingMode.display: Shows LH01 format: alternates running time (minutes) and running time (hours) every 2s.
agingMode.exit: Short press P to exit aging mode.

parameterEntry.errorOneKeyClear: When error shown, short press P to clear error and re-detect. If no error, alarm clears. If error persists, alarm continues. Works for E4, E5, E6, E9; E9 auto-recovers when pedal is normal.

errorCodes.solution: Check if machine head is stuck or dry/difficult to rotate. Check if fabric is too thick (insufficient torque). Check the motor and connection wires. Cannot be cleared with P key.
Check voltage status. Wait to restart (check power board functions carefully). Cannot be cleared with P key.
Check motor encoder plug connection reliability, signal wire integrity, and pin condition. Check Hall signal.
Check if position part is connected to control box. Check top/down signal. Long press - (or short press P to re-detect) to clear if no error.
Check if presser foot can return to original place. Short press P to re-detect.
Check pedal and its connection signal, plugs connected to control box. E9 auto-recovers when pedal is normal.
Check voltage. Wait to restart (check power board functions carefully). Cannot be cleared with P key.
Check voltage. Wait to restart (check power board carefully). Cannot be cleared with P key.
Check voltage. Wait to restart (check power board functions carefully).

errorCodes.description: Hard ware problem of drive circuit
errorCodes.solution: Check motor plug wires are well-connected. Check IGBT.
Check if current sensor is broken.
Check circuit between transition board and main board.
Check if trimming magnet (electromagnet) is damaged.
Check if presser foot magnet is damaged.
Detect Hall signal for static interference.

errorCodes.description: Alarm: up piece count is full
errorCodes.solution: Press P key to clear data and cancel alarm.

errorCodes.description: Alarm: down piece count is full
errorCodes.solution: Press P key to clear data and cancel alarm.

alarmCodes.description: Front sensor calibration alarm (前传感器校准警告)
Back sensor calibration alarm (后传感器校准警告)
Anti fabric cutting sensor calibration alarm (防切布传感器校准警告)
alarmCodes.solution: Detect / re-calibrate anti fabric cutting sensor.

alarmCodes.description: Fabric detection sensitivity alarm (面料识别灵敏度错误)
alarmCodes.solution: Fabric too thin — cannot be detected with current sensitivity.

alarmCodes.description: Fabric detection over-time alarm (面料识别超时警告)
Fabric alarm during detection — fabric present on table when starting recognition

troubleshooting.issue: Machine stuck in full-computer C mode
troubleshooting.cause: Trimmer mode set to 0 (off), or both indicators off
troubleshooting.solution: When trimmer mode=0, system auto-links to full computer C mode. Short press trimmer button to cycle to mode 1/2/3 for semi-automatic B mode, or set P5=1 directly.

troubleshooting.issue: Thread tail too long after front trim
troubleshooting.solution: Increase P-27 value. The bigger the value, the shorter the thread length will be after cut.

troubleshooting.issue: Thread tail too long on cloth after rear trim
troubleshooting.cause: P-28 delay stitches too large, or P-34 too large
troubleshooting.solution: Decrease P-28 (when P32=0) or decrease P-34. Smaller value = shorter thread on cloth.
Long press Sensor button 1s+ for auto-calibration. If shows A-01/A-02/A-03, detect the respective sensor. If A-04 (timeout), detect all 3 sensors.

troubleshooting.cause: Fabric not blocking all 3 sensors simultaneously, or wrong fabric type selected
troubleshooting.solution: Ensure fabric covers all 3 sensors at once. Long press Mesh button to confirm correct fabric type (B0/A/S) before starting recognition.
Long press trimmer button for 2s to unlock. P62 auto-clears to 0, shows UL.
